newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to set 97/98 GDP target at 6.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to set 97/98 GDP target at 6.0 pct.

text.p: Bangaladesh is expected to set the target of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth at 6.0 percent in fiscal 1997/98 beginning on July 1, Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said on Wednesday.
"We would continue to attract investment in industry and infrastructure. Our priority (for investment) is agriculture and human development," Kibria told Reuters in an interview.
He said: "Agriculture is very important in our economy and major contributor to the GDP. An overwhelming population is dependent on agriculture."
Kibria said Bangladesh was not in favour of giving subsidies except for agriculture "if necessary."
